name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you. Hinge, grip the handle with both hands, and hike it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward powerfully so the kettlebell swings up to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge your hips to guide it between your legs.
Keep your back flat and do not squat. The power comes from the hips, not the arms.
image_prompt_scene: Hinged forward with a kettlebell hanging between the legs and both hands on the handle.
